suite: klm-gamma conformance vectors (klm-gamma/1.0 frozen, klm-gamma/1.1, klm-label/1.0 frozen, klm-label/2.0)
contract: record_cases: every implementation claiming the stamped schema id MUST reach the stated verdict.
A reject MUST be for the stated reason: each string in error_contains must appear in some reported error.
Error wording is the reference validator's; a port may word errors differently and should map
error_contains to its own messages, but the verdict and the rule it names are the contract.
projection_cases: the pure label projections, evaluated with honest nulls as null (never zero).

record_cases.name: 1.0-invalid-example
error_contains: freshness_score is marked unavailable but carries value 0.2
coherence_score is null but has no nulls.coherence_score.reason

record_cases.name: 1.0-documented-case-stamped-stable-is-rejected
record_cases.note: grounded 0.833 / coherence 1.0 / evidence 0.75 / declared 0.488: under the published 1.0 body declared < 0.65, so not STABLE.

record_cases.name: 1.0-vendor-label-formula-not-recomputed
record_cases.note: The published 1.0 validator does not recompute labels under ids it does not know; frozen as-is. 1.1 closes this (see 1.1-unknown-label-formula).

record_cases.name: 1.0-top-level-coverage-score-rejected
record_cases.rule: 1.0 frozen: vendor extras belong under ext

record_cases.rule: A2 never guess the rule set

record_cases.name: 1.1-unavailable-component-without-reason

record_cases.name: 1.1-measured-status-but-no-value

record_cases.name: 1.1-valued-component-with-null-reason

error_contains: component_status.coherence is measured but carries a null reason

record_cases.name: 1.1-component-without-signal
record_cases.rule: A2 a valued component names what it measures
error_contains: component_status.coherence.signal (what the component measures) is required
